These little rituals can help signal to your mind and heart that it’s okay to let the day go, even if it didn’t go as planned.

And if you want, you could share with Jasper how much you look forward to your reading time, and that you missed it tonight. Sometimes, letting him know can open up a sweet moment of connection, even if it’s brief.

Most of all, be gentle with yourself. It’s okay to feel off when things don’t go as you hoped. The care you bring to these reflections is already helping you—and your family—find your way back to connection, even on the imperfect days.
